name: Obligation
definition: Specifies the assets (quantity of securities, goods, services, and cash amounts) that have to be delivered.

RequestedSettlementDate.name: Requested Settlement Date
RequestedSettlementDate.definition: Date and time at which a trade must be executed. For a direct debit, it is the date and time at which the creditor requests that the amount of money is to be collected from the debtor. For a credit transfer, it is the date and time at which the debtor requests the clearing agent to process the payment. For a securities trade, it is the date and time at which the securities are to be delivered or received.

RequestedSettlementAmount.name: Requested Settlement Amount
RequestedSettlementAmount.definition: Total amount of money to be paid or received.

Priority.name: Priority
Priority.definition: Specifies whether the transaction is to be executed with a high priority.

ExposureType.name: Exposure Type
ExposureType.definition: Type of exposure related to this obligation.

Trade.name: Trade
Trade.definition: Specifies the trade which originates the obligation to deliver a product, cash or securities..

TransactionRisk.name: Transaction Risk
TransactionRisk.definition: Transaction risk calculated per obligation type.

ParentObligation.name: Parent Obligation
ParentObligation.definition: Obligation which is divided into several sub-obligations.

SubObligation.name: Sub Obligation
SubObligation.definition: Specifies an obligation resulting from another existing obligation, for instance each leg of a financing agreement is a sub-obligation of the global financing obligation.

Offset.name: Offset
Offset.definition: Specifies the method used to settle a specific obligation.

OriginalObligationProcess.name: Original Obligation Process
OriginalObligationProcess.definition: Obligation fulfilment process which did not extinguish the obligation but replaced it by a new one, for instance in case of netting.

TreasuryTrade.name: Treasury Trade
TreasuryTrade.definition: Specifies trades linked to treasury operations such as the exchange of currencies, the lending of cash amounts and the related derivatives trades (options and non deliverable trades).
